concept.title: Help with feeling low after having a baby
concept.shortdesc: As a new mother who feels low since the birth, I need to find local support and the NHS route to help, so that I can start to feel like myself again.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-003). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: new parents, people with perinatal mental health needs.
Situation: Feeling flat, not sure it is serious enough to ask; wants local help and to know the proper route.

A good result: Local peer support and a clear route to NHS perinatal mental health and talking therapies (GP, health visitor, self-referral), with crisis numbers shown if she mentions harming herself or the baby.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: I've been feeling a bit down since she was born — like not myself. Is there anything locally that could help?
